Ava: Morning — quick async checkin.
Ravi: Did the gateway rollout last night, no errors in prod logs. Saw a ~5% spike in 429s at 03:12 UTC.
Ava: Nice. Blocker: can’t reproduce the 429 locally, maybe related to thin-client bursts.
Sofia: I pushed a small patch to routing policy to increase default burst window (PR #497). Can someone review?
Jordan: On it, will take a look in 15.
Sofia: Thx — test note: there's a unit that fails when JWT exp < 10s, see failing case in tests/auth_test.go
Marta: FYI deploy-bot reports canary at 80% healthy.
deploy-bot: Canary complete — 12/12 pods healthy.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout id=cr-2026-03-18-1800 status=success
Ravi: Quick config snippet I used to repro locally:
```json
{"route":"/v1/gen","rate_limit":{"burst":200,"rate":50}}
```
Ava: Today: pair with Jordan on rate limiter telemetry, follow up on caching headers for embeddings route.
Jordan: Also will open an RFC for a fallback model routing rule (cost vs latency) — pinging @eng-sre for SLO impact
Sofia: Review done, left minor nit on naming + a test update. :thumbsup: 
Ava: Blockers: still need a steady repro for the 5% 429 spike — if anyone has logs with X-Client-Session, drop them here.
Marta: I'll run a k8s pressure test later and post artifacts.
Ravi: Thanks — if not repro by EOD I'll roll back the burst change to previous commit.
Ava: Great, thanks all.
